notes: Summary: Arkstone is running an enterprise POC for Dedicated capacity. Primary goal = replace mixed cloud endpoints with reserved pool for low tail latency + predictable unit cost.
Key ask from CTO: sustained throughput guarantees for daytime trading windows, p95 latency guarantees for chat/rerank, and clear reserved GPU sizing recommendations.
From kickoff call (10/18): 'We need to make sure model fallbacks never spike p95 above 300ms during business hours' — CTO paraphrase.
Security: must meet SOC2, SSO (SAML), KMS integration, and data residency in us-east for trade logs. Air-gapped not required.
Procurement: interested in 12 month commitment with 3 month ramp; prefers monthly invoice. Procurement asked for penalty caps and uptime SLA details.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if per-token effective unit cost reduces by >=35% vs hosted bursts.
Model preference: want to test instruction-tuned 13B + 70B (quantized) families. Open to Redwood model catalog; want test matrix with 3 quant levels.
Routing/fallback: needs policy to fallback to smaller quantized variant automatically on saturation; must preserve context for long chats (KV cache keep-alive requirement).
Integration: SRE will handle VPC peering, but needs clear network port list and expected egress for load tests.
POC timeline: 2-week functional POC -> 1 week load tests -> 72h soak -> SLA negotiation meeting.
Quote from SE: 'We will recommend a mixed H100 / A100 pool to balance latency and cost; will size based on token/sec measured in step load.'
Internal: AE and SE aligned on mid-6 figure ARR upside if SLA acceptable and soak passes.
Next meeting scheduled 2024-11-05 to review soak test plan and draft SLA language.
Drive links shared: pricing deck + security answers. Jira tickets opened for network whitelisting.

p0_requirements: Throughput: baseline 400 QPS sustained for chat rerank mix, peak bursts to 1,000 QPS for 5m
Latency: p95 <= 200ms for short chat messages (<=128 tokens); p95 <= 350ms for mixed-length rerank ops
Availability: target 99.95% monthly for production; want explicit SLO and incident credit terms
Context: must preserve KV cache across requests for session continuity up to 6k tokens
Data controls: encryption at rest and in transit, KMS key usage, audit log retention 12 months
perf_targets: Load: run step-ramp to 80% of theoretical capacity over 30m intervals
Soak: 72-hour steady-state at 70% sustained load with intermittent 5m peak spikes
SLA metric verification: track p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, error-rate, GPU utilization
Cost telemetry: token/sec cost, GPU hour burn, effective per-1k-token cost across quantization configs
poc_plan: Phase 1 (functional): validate model outputs, function-calling, and KV cache correctness — 2 business days
Phase 2 (load): synthetic workload with replayed production traces (anonymized) — 5 days
Phase 3 (soak): 72h steady-state run at 70% with scheduled peak bursts — capture full telemetry
Phase 4 (analysis): joint review of results, cost model, and recommended reserved GPU count — 3 days
Deliverables: load test report, latency SLO appendix, recommended reserve pool (type + count), SLA draft
representative_prompts: Chat: 'Given my last 5 messages, summarize the trading rationale and highlight anomalies in positions A and B.'
Rerank: 'Rank these candidate trade signals by probability of false positive; include short score justification.'
Embedding: 'Produce dense embedding for this 400-word product description for semantic search.'
Summarization: 'Condense this 2-page compliance document into a 6-bullet summary with action items.'
